The short facts for disposal of the Rule are that on 16.10.1991 the present opposite parties No.1-3 as pre-emptors filed an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act alleging, inter-that the land measuring 6.98 acres of C.S Khatian No.12, the land measuring 12.87 acres of C.S Khatian No.90 was recorded in S.A. Khatian No.26, the land measuring 5.11 acres of C.S Khatian No.22 was recorded in S.A. Khatian No.50. The suit. land comprise .92 acres of those two S.A. Khatian. 

 Entire land of the Khatians originally belonged 4 annas of Sharat Mondal, 4 annas of 7 sons of Chandiram , 8 annas are the sons of Khelaram, Madar, Kalicharan, Mohadeb, Fakir Dadhiram, Sree Ram and Chiranjibi are 7 sons of Chandiram, Dadhiram and Sree Ram died before marriage and their Shere passed to sons of Madar, Mahadeb and Fakir. Madar died leaving 4 annas, pre-emptor No.1 and opposite party Nos. 8.9 and 17 Khalicharan died leaving behind opposite party no.3, Mahadeb died leaving one son, the pre-emptee No.2. Banamali, the son of Fakir died leaving his 3 brothers, are pre-emptor no.3 and opposite party nos.10 and 11. Durgacharan and Sashi sons of Khelaram died before marriage leaving 3 brothers namely Haran, Sarup, and Santosh, Haran died leaving 3 sons opposite party nos. 1217 and 18 and Santosh died leaving 3 sons the opposite party nos. 13-15 and pre-emptee no.I3 got the share of Sarup by a gift. The pre-emptee nos. 3-6 transferred the suit land on 14.7.1991 by registered Kabala deed at a price of Tk. 35.000/- to the pre-emptee no. I and 2, who are not co-sharer of the suit land. No notice was served upon the pre-emptor and they for the first time, came to learn about the transfer on. 3. 10. 1991 by obtaining a certified copy of the Kabala dated 14.7.1991.
